description: Source code for ISC RichTextEditor module, defining classes and functions for rich text editing in SmartClient framework.

classes.name: RichTextCanvas
classes.description: Class extending Canvas, providing rich text editing capabilities with support for different browsers and internal content management.

classes.name: RichTextEditor
classes.description: Main class extending VLayout, providing a rich text editing interface with toolbar controls, font and style options, and content management.

classes.name: RichTextItem
classes.description: CanvasItem subclass integrating RichTextEditor into form items, mapping values and handling focus and updates.

methods.name: supportsRichTextEditing
methods.description: Checks if the current browser supports rich text editing features.

methods.name: initWidget
methods.description: Initializes the RichTextCanvas widget, setting up content and event handlers.

methods.name: setContents
methods.description: Sets the inner HTML content of the rich text editor.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Retrieves the current HTML content from the editor.

methods.name: createLink
methods.description: Creates a hyperlink at the current selection.
